nodes.label: PWA App Icon 192px
nodes.description: 192x192 PNG PWA app icon with rounded square shape. Green gradient background (medium to dark green). Displays a bar chart (4 ascending bars in white/light green tones) on the left and a Russian Ruble currency symbol (₽) in white on the right. Represents a family budget / financial tracking application. Clean, minimal design suitable for home screen installation.
nodes.purpose: PWA home screen icon, also used in web app manifest
